assist.exactQuestion: Acquire materially new primary or independent evidence reusable by the root owner to close source-addressed underwriting gaps.

observations.fact: Mobileye announced on July 30, 2026 that it is scheduled to participate in Evercore's 9th Annual ADAS, AV & AI Forum on September 29, 2026 and plans to webcast its fireside chats when possible.
The announced September 29 forum is a near-term issuer communication event but does not itself guarantee new operating guidance, customer awards, financial disclosure, or a change in fundamentals.

factors.name: catalystScore
factors.basis: A scheduled September 29 ADAS/AV/AI investor forum is a dated near-term information event that can surface execution updates, but the issuer has not promised new material disclosure.

factors.name: executionMonitoring
factors.basis: The event provides a concrete monitoring checkpoint for advanced ADAS, autonomy and physical-AI execution narratives already present in cumulative evidence.

risks: Treating conference participation as a fundamental catalyst would overstate the evidence; it is an information checkpoint, not proof of execution.
unknowns: Exact fireside-chat time and whether a webcast will be available were not specified in the July 30 announcement.
No new operating or financial disclosure can be assumed before the event occurs.
confidence: high for event date and issuer participation; low for incremental information content before the event
